selected_concept.economic_question: Do successive one-minute upper and lower price boundaries move together, indicating coherent repricing of the whole traded interval rather than transient range expansion or contraction?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: When minute highs and lows translate in the same direction, the whole traded interval is being accepted at a new level. More coherent boundary translation may indicate persistent information incorporation that carries from the next open through the third close.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Use exactly 119 adjacent high/low-boundary changes in each 120-bar half at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; exclude 09:30, lunch, overnight, cross-day, and cross-stock transitions.
